七滴血？？我只有七滴血？还是满血？？好家伙！我直接好家伙！“哟！醒了！”有人注意到方羽的情况。“起来，刁德一，还装死呢？”啪！一个满脸胡渣，头顶[王二]名字的男人，一巴掌直接打在方羽脸上。火辣辣的疼痛感，立刻让方羽惊了。卧槽！这拟真度！这npc的神情动作！绝了！这游戏绝对火！绝对会爆火！与此同时，他头顶冒出一个数字。“-1。”等，等等等等等！这个痛感，你告诉我只掉了一滴血？转念一想，他角色一共也就7点血，一下少了7分之1，痛一点好像也是合理的。不过这痛觉绝对要调一下。方羽压低声音：“系统，打开设置页面。”然而……并没有任何反应。方羽一愣。旁边王二则一把将他从躺着的桌子上推下来。“你小子在嘀咕什么，对你王爹有意见是吧？”砰。方羽摔在地上。“-05。”05的血也能掉的？？方羽懵了，而随着视线下移，他看到了一只手。断手。“卧槽！？”方羽连忙用手托地爬起，双手立刻染上黏糊糊的血液。再看周围，不大的房间中，周围亮着七八个血条，其中一个人还显示着，。定眼一看，赫然是断了手的那家伙，奄奄一息的。其他人也都是有3点4点的剩余血量，躺在地上哼哼唧唧。方羽惊呆在原地。这特么什么情况，凶杀现场？“大惊小怪的。”王二走到李安面前，抓住李安的头发，将他脑袋拽起。“再问一遍，钱呢？”“钱……钱在，那块砖头下面……求……求……”啪！王二将李安脑袋往地下一砸！-1！大大的数字直接跳出。李安当场昏迷了过去，头顶断断续续的还冒着‘-01’‘-01’的数字显示。这是要死人了啊！但王二却不管，把砖块挖开，果然下面藏着一袋银子，略一掂量，分量还不少。王二露出了笑脸，可周围却有人喊道。“王二！这钱你不能拿！那是掌柜留给夫人治病的钱！没了这笔钱夫人就死定了！”“王哥，拿了这笔钱，你和杀人有什么区别？就算你为赌场卖命，也得留点良心啊！”“就是就是！掌柜的又不是不还钱，你们进来就又打又砸，难道眼里就没有王法了吗！”听着周围的声音，王二冷笑出声。“欠债还钱，天经地义！老子不管你家掌柜是怎么欠下这笔钱的，该还钱的时候见不到钱，那就是他的问题！还有，你们算什么东西？一天也就10钱，你们拼什么命！”说着，他看向方羽。“刁德一，过去打他！”“啊？我？”“废话！你不打他，我就打你！打到你手脚都断了为止！别忘了，你在给我们卖命！你不干活，明天就把你姐押到烟柳巷卖身！”旁边的赵天这时也笑了。“还债时演的姐弟情深，原来全是假的啊，连为你姐姐打人的勇气都没有，还说什么愿意为她受苦啊。”不是，您也别阴阳怪气啊，那也不是我演的啊，角色自己帮姐姐担下的压力，管我什么事，我又没做过！再说了，刁德一归刁德一，我是我，能一样吗。不过……方羽忽然有了点想法，默默走到那人面前。在彭西恶狠狠的眼神中，方羽举起拳头，一拳打在他胸口，没用太多力。“-01。”方羽：……彭西：？轻飘飘的拳头，让彭西毫无反应，愣愣地低头看着方羽的拳头。后面的王二顿时就爆发了。“干嘛！打人都没力气！吃干饭的啊！给老子用力！”其他三个打手则哄笑了起来，哄笑中对着这家药店的伙计就是邦邦几拳。“-1。”“-1。”“-1。”伤害数字纷纷其他伙计身上跳出。“看清楚了，刁德一，拳头是这么用的！”“打人都没力气，要你有什么用！”“脚！拳头没力气就用脚踹！懂吧？狠狠的打！你不打人，就要挨我们的打！”果然！方羽心中闪过明悟。这肯定就是系统安排的新手教程啊。教他怎么战斗的，就是这个木桩和新手过程剧情，有点让人不太舒服。不过没关系，都是npc而已。握紧拳头，方羽这次全力出拳！砰！打中伙计鼻梁。“-1。”伤害跳出。“哎哟！打得不错啊！”“可以！这一拳得到了我的认可！”王二等人喝彩。方羽也找到了感觉，再出一拳，随着“-1”的数字出现，把人直接打到了的血量。看着昏死过去的‘木桩’，他寻思，再出两三拳，应该能把人打死。但他有些犹豫，要他打死这么活灵活现的npc，让他感觉怪怪的，就好像真的把活人打死了似的，有点下不去手。再扫了眼周围，好家伙，王二这些人全都克制的很，只是把人打到1点2点的血量就纷纷停手了，就没人是真的下死手的。还好自己机智观察了一波，否则愣头青把人直接打死了，指不定要出什么事呢。正想着呢，药房里屋的门忽然被拉开，一个穿着青衣，神态憔悴的美貌女子，落入众人视线。好家伙，第一次见到血上限只有3点的角色，弱不禁风啊。看到药店众人惨状，陈奇兰神色一滞，吓得面无血色，满脸惊恐，当场发出尖叫。“啊啊啊啊！！”店里伙计纷纷色变。“内当家！”“内当家快回屋里去！”内当家？那岂不是就是掌柜夫人？掌柜夫人想逃，可王二哪里会让她走。在看见这女人的第一眼时，王二的眼神就像是吃人的老虎，满脸的！大步过去，一手抓住要转身逃跑的女人。-05。大手在女人胳膊落下印记，将她按倒在桌上。“兄弟们，今天有福了。我先上，等会轮到你们，刁德一也有份。”方羽：？？？这么照顾我？方羽寻思他要是放下道德压力，这岂不是要在这里作威作福，作恶到飞起！这特么也太坏了吧，咱不想当个坏比啊。

Seven drops of blood? ? I only have seven drops of blood? Still full of blood? ? Good guy! I'm a good guy! "Hey! Wake up!" Someone noticed Fang Yu's condition. "Get up, Diao Deyi, are you still pretending to be dead?" Bang! A man with a beard and the name [Wang Er] above his head slapped Fang Yu directly in the face. The burning pain immediately startled Fang Yu. Damn it! Such realism! This npc’s facial expressions and movements! Absolutely amazing! This game is absolutely popular! It will definitely explode! At the same time, a number appeared above his head. "-1." Wait, wait, wait, wait! This pain, you tell me, only a drop of blood fell? After thinking about it, his character only had 7 points of health in total, which was 1/7 less. It seemed reasonable to feel a little more pain. But this pain definitely needs to be adjusted. Fang Yu lowered his voice: "System, open the settings page." However... there was no response. Fang Yu was stunned. Wang Er next to him pushed him off the table where he was lying. "What are you muttering about? Do you have a problem with your father?" Bang. Fang Yu fell to the ground. "-05." Can the blood of 05 be lost? ? Fang Yu was stunned, and as his eyes moved downward, he saw a hand. Severed hand. "What the hell!?" Fang Yu quickly climbed up with his hands on the ground, his hands immediately stained with sticky blood. Looking around again, in the small room, there are seven or eight health bars shining around, and one of them is still showing,. After taking a closer look, it turned out to be the guy with the broken hand, who was dying. Everyone else also had 3 to 4 points of remaining health, lying on the ground groaning. Fang Yu was stunned on the spot. What the hell is this, a murder scene? "What a fuss." Wang Er walked up to Li An, grabbed Li An's hair, and pulled his head up. "Ask me again, where is the money?" "The money...the money is under that brick...please...please..." Bang! Wang Er smashed Li An's head into the ground! -1! Big numbers pop up immediately. Li An passed out on the spot, and the numbers '-01' and '-01' were displayed intermittently on his head. This is going to kill people! But Wang Er ignored it and dug out the bricks. Sure enough, there was a bag of silver hidden underneath. After weighing it a little, it turned out that it was quite a lot. Wang Er showed a smile, but someone shouted around him. "Wang Er! You can't take this money! That's the money the shopkeeper left for my wife's medical treatment! Without this money, my wife will be dead!" "Brother Wang, if you take this money, what's the difference between you and murdering someone? Even if you work for the casino, you still have to keep some conscience!" "That's right! The shopkeeper doesn't refuse to pay back the money, and you guys come in and beat and smash them. Don't you have the law in your eyes?" Listening to the sounds around him, Wang Er sneered. "It's natural to pay back debts! I don't care how your shopkeeper owes this money. If he can't see the money when he should pay it back, that's his problem! Also, who do you think you are? It's only 10 yuan a day, why are you working so hard!" As he said, he looked at Fang Yu. "Diao Deyi, go over and beat him!" "Huh? Me?" "Nonsense! If you don't beat him, I will beat you! Beat you until your hands and feet are broken! Don't forget, you are working for us! If you don't work, your sister will be taken to Yanliu Lane tomorrow to sell herself!" Zhao Tian next to him also laughed at this time. "The deep brother-sister relationship I played when repaying debts turned out to be all fake. I don't even have the courage to hit someone for your sister, so why are I willing to suffer for her?" No, don't be weird, that's not what I acted. The character took on the pressure for my sister. No matter what, I didn't do it! Besides, Diao Deyi will return to Diao Deyi, I am me, can it be the same? But... Fang Yu suddenly had an idea and silently walked up to the man. Under Peng west's vicious eyes, Fang Yu raised his fist and punched him in the chest without using much force. "-01." Fang Yu:...Peng west:? Peng west had no reaction to the light fist, and stared blankly down at Fang Yu's fist. Wang Er in the backIt broke out immediately. "What are you doing! You don't even have the strength to hit anyone! You're a bastard! Give me a hard time!" The other three thugs burst into laughter, and punched the pharmacy clerk several times in the middle of the laughter. "-1." "-1." "-1." Damage numbers popped up on other guys. "See clearly, Diao Deyi, this is how your fists are used!" "You don't have the strength to hit people, so what's the use of you!" "Foot! If your fists don't have the strength, just kick them with your feet! Understand? Hit them hard! If you don't hit them, you will be beaten by us!" Sure enough! A realization flashed through Fang Yu's heart. This must be the novice tutorial arranged by the system. What teaches him how to fight is the stakes and the novice process plot, which is a bit uncomfortable. But it doesn't matter, they are just NPCs. Clenching his fists, Fang Yu punched with all his strength this time! Bang! Hit the guy on the bridge of the nose. "-1." The damage pops up. "Ouch! That's a good fight!" "Yes! This punch is approved by me!" Wang Er and others cheered. Fang Yu also found the feeling, and punched again. As the number "-1" appeared, he hit the person's health directly. Looking at the unconscious 'wooden pile', he thought that if he punched the person two or three more times, he should be able to kill him. But he was a little hesitant. Asking him to kill such a vivid NPC made him feel weird, as if he had really beaten a living person to death, and he was a little reluctant to do it. I glanced around again, good guys, Wang Er and others were all very restrained. They just beat people to 1 or 2 points of health and then stopped, so no one really killed them. Fortunately, he made a quick observation, otherwise Leng Tou Qing would have beaten the person to death, and something might have happened. Just as he was thinking about it, the door of the back room of the pharmacy was suddenly opened, and a beautiful woman in green clothes with a haggard expression fell into everyone's sight. Good guy, this is the first time I see a character with a blood limit of only 3 points. He is so weak. Seeing the miserable condition of everyone in the pharmacy, Chen Qilan's expression froze, her face turned pale with fear, and she screamed on the spot. "Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!!" The waiters in the store all changed their expressions. "The inner boss!" "The inner boss, go back to the house quickly!" The inner boss? Isn't that the shopkeeper's wife? The shopkeeper's wife wanted to run away, but Wang Er wouldn't let her go. When he saw this woman for the first time, Wang Er's eyes were like those of a man-eating tiger, all over his face! He strode over and grabbed the woman who was about to turn around and run away with one hand. -05. His big hand left a mark on the woman's arm and pushed her down on the table. "Brothers, you are blessed today. I will go first. It will be your turn later. Diao Deyi will also take part." Fang Yu:? ? ? Take care of me like this? Fang Yu thought that if he let go of his moral pressure, wouldn't he be able to dominate and do evil here? This is too damn bad. We don’t want to be a bad comparison.
